metadata.description: Bryan's Claude Code plugins. Skills install via `npx skills add ctrlShiftBryan/skills`; only subagents ship as plugins.

plugins.name: datadog-fetcher
plugins.description: Offload Datadog MCP read calls to a Haiku-powered sub-agent to cut token cost. Auto-delegates whenever the main agent would query Datadog logs, metrics, monitors, traces/spans, events, hosts, services, dashboards, incidents, RUM, or notebooks. Runs the minimum set of read queries, saves full raw payloads to tmp/datadog/<timestamp>-<slug>.json, and returns a capped (~500-token) markdown summary with numbers, timestamps, example IDs, and caveats. Read-only — notebook/dashboard writes and auth/setup stay in the main agent. Requires the official datadog plugin's MCP server.
